title: Industrial Safety Relay & Emergency Stop Price Pakistan 2026: SIL/PLe Category 4 Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete Pakistan 2026 buyer guide to industrial safety relays, emergency stop buttons, safety light curtains and two-hand controls. SIL 2/3 vs PLc/PLd/PLe, dual-channel wiring, stop Category 0/1/2, PKR price tables, PSQCA requirements, 5-city sourcing. Covers EN ISO 13849-1, IEC 62061, EN 60204-1 stop categories, positively guided contacts, EDM feedback wiring, safety distance calculations for press brakes and injection moulding.
